notes: Image fills now arrive as the whole original image, larger than the frame or rectangle, so you can move and rescale it in After Effects.
If the shape fills the whole frame, the image just runs past the comp edges. If it's smaller, a mask called Figma shape trims it like Figma does; slide the image inside with the Pan Behind tool (Y).
New: Preferences (the gear) ▸ Create test frames adds a page with three test frames full of shapes, strokes, rotations and flips.
testFocus: Send your Meta social frames again: the photo should be one full-size image layer that extends past the comp, lined up with the Figma Reference.
In a new Figma file, click Create test frames, send all three frames and work through the Accuracy checklist.
